channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Creative Australia: International Engagement Fund (October 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/international-engagement-fund
    Creative Australia · deadline 13 Oct 2026 · AUD 5,000 to 30,000. No application fee. No formal matching requirement, but assessment explicitly weighs diversity and scale of income and co-funding, including earned income, grants, sponsorship and in-kind contributions.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/arts-projects-organisations

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Canon Oceania: Grants Program 2026
    https://www.canon.com.au/about-canon/community/grants
    Canon Oceania · deadline Closed 14 Jun 2026 · Each grant worth 5,000 in local currency (AUD or NZD): 2,500 cash plus 2,500 in Canon product. Awarded across four categories: Education, Community, Environment, and First Nations/Cultural. More than 50,000 awarded across the region. No application fee.
  • Blackbird Foundation: Protostars Micro-Grant (Young People's Passion Projects)
    https://www.blackbird.foundation/protostars
    Blackbird Foundation · deadline Closed 21 Jun 2026 · AUD 1,000 micro-grant per recipient. No application fee.
  • Blackbird Foundation: Believers Fund III 2026
    https://www.blackbird.foundation/projects
    Blackbird Foundation · deadline 30 Jun 2027 · AUD 5,000 and AUD 10,000 grants. No application fee.
